name: Magmadar
source: [core: vmangos] Melee 1,867 to 2,475 a 2.0 s swing before armor: vmangos core (github.com/vmangos/core, db_latest db-4641790): creature_template, spell_template, the boss script, melee_damage(level 63) 127.7 x damage_multiplier 17. a 2006 Molten Core full clear from Blizzard's servers in WWS format (web.mit.edu/cat/project/WoW/MCDump200609/), hits after armor: 102 hits, 763 average after armor, fits it. Lava Breath 19272 1,157 to 1,343 Fire, frontal, the log's average 624. Frenzy's timer from the script.
notes: Frenzy (+150% attack speed for 8 s, every 15 to 20 s) is left out: raids remove it with Tranquilizing Shot. Magma Spit (a Fire DoT on attackers), Panic (fear) and Lava Bomb are left out. Lava Breath's timer is assumed (the script triggers it with Frenzy in cmangos).

healing.notes: A 40-player Molten Core raid's main tank: 4 healers at 400 HPS each on it in 2 s heals (800 a heal), a mix of paladins on Flash of Light rank 6 (about 600 at 400 healing power) and priests on Greater Heal rank 4 or downranked Heal. 1,600 HPS before overheal, 2.4 times an assumed 650 DTPS, the Classic Era Molten Core logs' ratio (wowsims/forever).
